title: A Smart Options Trade for Stocks that Could Double (Ratio Diagonal)
summary: Levi Woods (Kelowna, BC; ~12 yrs options, second channel appearance) pitches a call ratio diagonal: buy 3 long-dated OTM calls on a stock that could double (CHWY, PLTR) and finance their theta by selling 2 near-dated slightly-OTM calls each week, sized to stay net-long-delta (~+72) AND net-positive-theta at once — something a plain long call or PMCC can't do. Downside is cleanly defined (all calls, max loss ~= the debit) with a small bounded upside 'valley' from the 2:3 ratio; self-rated risk 4/10. Honest for the channel (he volunteers that the long-put variation lost, that his target names carry 30-40c spreads, and that the trade requires a directional view), but there is no separable track record — ~6 self-reported trades in a benign 6-month window and a showcased 'annualized 120%' Chewy trade that is open, unrealized, and mark-to-model. Edge is really stock selection plus thin weekly roll credits that wide spreads and commissions likely eat. Write-up: strategies/ratio_diagonal.md (conviction 2/5).
